name: bounded_state_first_delegation_three_arm_v1
selection: all parents; first actual task_declared regardless of outcome; no-delegation parents reported without fabricating a Worker
source_replay: Actual autoregressive regeneration from recorded fresh-state request; input, generated and prefix tokens plus original published source cache hash must match. Never force reference output.
fusion_selection: Whole actual tokens inside public_background/current_state JSON values and current generated reason/command/deliverable/success_criteria string values. Boundaries remain native. Ambiguous generated character mapping is a retained scope failure.
selection_limitations: Includes control records and historical claims; causal effects of previous control are not removed. Fixed provenance rule, no trained selection, dense projection, no zero-copy.
tools: Each arm uses only its own actual inspect/check feedback; free Worker output with the same transport compatibility; no global commits or online Planner continuation.
handoff: Actual additional 4B generation from a private branch of the same source cache; useful solutions and evidence permitted; incomplete handoff remains a paid preparation failure.
comparison_scope: C2C versus native full text is the fixed-snapshot mechanism contrast. Practical handoff adds source task assistance and is a quality/cost competitor, not a pure medium intervention.
failure_policy: Keep every parent, preparation failure, truncation, tool exhaustion and semantic error. No prompt search or reruns selected by quality.
